en.tagline: Surf, chill and feel at home in Ahangama

copyBlocks.heading: A two-minute walk from Kabalana
copyBlocks.body:
Small, new, and about as close to the wave as you can sleep. One dorm, a garden, and a family who built the place and still run it.

It is quiet. Guests keep saying so, and they mean it as the main point.

copyBlocks.heading: One dorm, and that is deliberate
copyBlocks.body:
There is a single dormitory here. No second building, no crowd, nobody checking in at three in the morning. Everyone who writes about the place lands on the same two words: clean and quiet.

Every category on Hostelworld sits at 10 out of 10 — value, security, atmosphere, cleanliness, staff, location, facilities. Ten reviews is a small sample. It is also a perfect one.

copyBlocks.heading: Newly built, and kept that way
copyBlocks.body: The showers, the beds, the storage: all of it is new and it gets cleaned daily by the people who own it. One guest extended her stay and wrote that she did not want to leave, which is the sentence this place earns most often.

copyBlocks.heading: The room
copyBlocks.body:
One air-conditioned dormitory, with real luggage space, a wardrobe, lockers and hot showers. There is a shared kitchen with a kettle, a dishwasher and everything you need to cook, plus a dining area, a terrace and a garden to sit in afterwards.

Rates move with the season and the dates — the booking links show what is free.

copyBlocks.heading: Finding the door
copyBlocks.body:
This is the one thing worth reading twice. Follow the map to Warnagiri, Welhengoda. There is a large black gate — open it. Through the gate there is a wooden platform, and the door to Layday is on the right of the house.

Guests have got lost here. Now you will not.

copyBlocks.heading: Practicalities
copyBlocks.body:
Check in between 14:00 and 19:00, check out by 14:00. Taxes are included and the property does not take credit cards. Non-smoking throughout.

Free private parking, free WiFi, laundry, daily housekeeping, bicycle rental, and an airport shuttle if you want one. Pets are welcome at no charge.

testimonials.quote: LayDay is so wonderful! Newly built and so well designed, Rukshan has thought of everything. As a solo female traveller I felt totally safe - it's a peaceful little sanctuary in Ahangama, just a 2-min walk to Kabalana Beach and great food spots. Super comfy beds, loads of luggage space, amazing showers, and absolutely spotless. Rukshan and his family are so kind and he keeps it immaculate daily. I extended my stay way longer than expected and didn't want to leave - will 100% be back!
testimonials.author: Beth, England

testimonials.quote: Well located, very clean, good air conditioning and a great host! Layday Surf is just one dorm room with 4 bunk beds so it is very quiet which was amazing. A little bit difficult to find but the host was very responsive and promises a sign will be put up ASAP.
testimonials.author: Catherine, Australia

testimonials.quote: Seriously the best hostel I've stayed in throughout my 7 months travelling. I'm so sad I wasn't there for long because it was just so so nice. Super clean, nice style, the showers are great, it's cosy, there's a nice inside place to sit & hang out. The lovely family who own this make such an effort to be present and helpful. HIGHLY recommend!
testimonials.author: Jennine, England

testimonials.quote: New and clean, walking distance straight to the beach
